text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...It's okay! I changed my shoes!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The spare shoes are fitted properly too! 
...See, they don't feel off at all.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...There's nothing strange about it...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (There's nothing at all!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaaaaaaah!!

A desperate roar, as if trying to shake 
something off... Satono Diamond kicks up 
the turf, her fighting spirit bursting 
forth.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...Satono Diamond falls short! The dream 
of becoming a Derby Umamusume was just too 
far away--!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(My shoes... were totally fine. And yet, 
I... I kept worrying about them the whole 
time I ran...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (What a pathetic run this is...!!)

Ever since returning to the waiting room, 
Satono Diamond had remained completely 
silent.
choice_data_list: It's a shame we couldn't win, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...No, Trainer. My loss was solely due to 
my own inadequacy."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While I was running, I couldn't stop 
worrying about my shoes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it doesn't feel off at all, 
you keep checking over and over that 
there's nothing wrong!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Back then, I... I shrank back from the 
jinx..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I let the jinx get in my head, couldn't 
run my best, and lost!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I find myself so pathetic, and I just 
can't forgive it!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I won't let the jinx beat me! Even though 
I swore so wholeheartedly!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...On the path to fulfilling Satono's 
dream, I cannot allow even a shred of 
doubt to remain!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If a mighty jinx stands in my way, then I 
shall cultivate the power to overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The strength to conquer any hardship! The 
flawless preparation to handle anything!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
With overwhelming ability, whether it's 
bad luck or a jinx, I will crush it 
utterly!

A declaration of absolute victory, so 
refreshing to hear. —I'm thoroughly 
impressed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: Leave the training menu to me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu! As expected of my Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to show you a flawless race 
at the Kikuka Sho!

On the way back from the racetrack, I 
invited Satono Diamond to a cafe.

To give her a boost of good luck as she 
challenges the jinx, I should treat her to 
some sweets.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
May I really order whatever I like...? 
Umm... even a fruit parfait with 
cheesecake on top...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's add triple scoops of ice 
cream, put in shiratama mochi and jelly, 
and extra fruit...
choice_data_list: Pile on as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if you put any more on top, it's 
going to spill over. Thank you for the 
meal, Trainer♪

...And then, a familiar name drifted over 
from a nearby table.

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"The interim results for the Takarazuka 
Kinen fan vote are in! In 1st place is 
Kitasan Black!!"

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! I voted for you too, so I'm 
super happy!

In the Takarazuka Kinen, where the runners 
are decided by fan vote, Kitasan Black 
took 1st place in the interim results 
announcement.

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) was incredible, 
wasn't it! Kitasan Black got overtaken 
once, but fought back to finish 
practically side-by-side!

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"That was so thrilling, wasn't it~! Pure, 
relentless guts!"

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She runs with everything she's got, so you 
just can't help cheering for her. It's 
like, she's so single-minded, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally! That girl's not flashy 
or anything, just kinda normal. Feels like 
she's one of us.

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's why you end up rooting for them to 
win! It feels like your own efforts are 
being rewarded, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I think so too! Those two over there 
understand Kita-chan's strengths so well!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan... During Hatsumode, your goal 
was to get more people to cheer for you, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've already achieved it.
choice_data_list:
Well, you did get first place in the fan 
vote.

You got first place in the fan vote, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And what's more, the fans were 
happily talking about Kita-chan's race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to bring smiles to everyone who 
supports me— and I'm getting closer to 
that goal.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...We can't afford to fall behind, can we?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I have to become someone worthy of running 
as Kita-chan's rival...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan might be running way ahead right 
now, but I'll push forward on my own path 
and definitely catch up!
choice_data_list:
All the more reason we can't afford to 
lose the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Kikuka Sho, which Kita-chan won 
last year. I absolutely cannot afford to 
lose this race!
